notice: Attributed minimum excerpts for deterministic tests; verify official sources before operational use.

requirements.exact_quote: if the representation is made through both visual and audible means, the disclosure should be made in the communication's visual and audible portions.
requirements.trigger: an endorsement representation is communicated through both visual and audible means
requirements.required_action: provide the disclosure in both the visual and audible portions

requirements.locator: Requirements for promoting a brand, product, or service
requirements.exact_quote: When posting content that promotes a brand, product, or service on TikTok, you must turn on the content disclosure setting.
requirements.trigger: posting content that promotes a brand, product, or service on TikTok
requirements.required_action: turn on the platform content disclosure setting
requirements.scope: synthetic TikTok-like creator commerce post; platform policy, not law

requirements.exact_quote: We also require creators to label all AI-generated content that contains realistic images, audio, and video, as explained in our Community Guidelines.
requirements.trigger: publishing AI-generated content containing realistic images, audio, or video
requirements.exception: TikTok may automatically label content made only with qualifying TikTok AI effects
requirements.scope: synthetic TikTok-like AIGC promotional post; platform policy, not law

requirements.exact_quote: Providers of AI systems, including general-purpose AI systems, generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content, shall ensure that the outputs of the AI system are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated.
requirements.actor: provider of an AI system generating synthetic content
requirements.trigger: the AI system generates synthetic audio, image, video, or text content
requirements.required_action: mark outputs in a machine-readable format detectable as artificially generated or manipulated
requirements.exception: assistive standard editing that does not substantially alter input data or semantics, and specified law-enforcement uses
requirements.scope: provider-side synthetic content output; actor applicability requires human review

requirements.exact_quote: Providers of AI systems, including general-purpose AI systems, generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content, that have been placed on the market before 2 August 2026 shall take the necessary steps in order to comply with Article 50(2) by 2 December 2026.
requirements.actor: provider of a covered AI system placed on the market before 2 August 2026
requirements.trigger: the covered system was placed on the market before 2 August 2026
requirements.required_action: take the necessary steps to comply with Article 50(2) by 2 December 2026
requirements.scope: transition timing for provider-side Article 50(2) obligations; actor, market-placement date, and territorial applicability require human review
